My work sits at the intersection of **climate science, heat stress, environmental data science, and measurement**. A recurring question is how definitions, aggregation choices, and spatial or temporal resolution affect the scientific and policy conclusions drawn from environmental data.

## Current and recent projects

### [Mind the (Jensen) Gap](/projects/jensen-gap/)
**Under peer review · Ecological Economics**

How nonlinear aggregation and thresholding can systematically change measured heat risk.

### [Metric dependence in seasonal heat-stress timing](/projects/wbgt-utci/)
**Manuscript in preparation**

Why heat metrics that track one another closely hour-to-hour can select substantially different periods as the hottest part of the year.

### [Changing temporal organisation of heat events across India](/projects/heat-event-timing/)
**Thesis-derived manuscript in preparation**

Onset, duration, persistence, and recovery periods in hourly UTCI over 1980–2024.
